notes: r3 investigator: 5 real press-brake folds on a physical scan (base plate with a 17 mm lip along one long edge; at each short end one tall flange plus one 30 mm tab sharing the end edge line). Lines use the original prep; only B5 needs a per-bend margin (12 mm) because the base next to tab 11/12 is deformed over the first ~10 mm (strips 21/22 tilted ~10 deg), which starved the default 6.8 mm support zone. Patches 13-22 are bend-radius or edge strips, not folds; the ~10 deg sag next to tab 11/12 is bend-zone deformation, not a separate bend.

bends.note: lip fold base|lip 7 (outer skin), ~90.6 deg bend, runs the full 373 mm edge
tall end flange 3/4 fold (outer skin), ~90.4 deg bend, relief to lip corner
tall inclined end flange 5/6 fold (~110 deg bend); inner-skin pair, apex lands on the outer arc (same locus as 2|5 within 0.1 mm)
tab 9/10 fold, ~90 deg; inner-skin pair because the base bottom skin is unscanned next to this tab; apex on the outer arc (matches 2|10 within 0.05 mm)
tab 11/12 fold, ~65.7 deg bend (outer skin); margin 12 so the support zone reaches past the deformed base strip next to the fold; margins 10-14 all give the same 46.9 mm line
